summary: First iteration MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (auth, sensors, alerts, webhook, public endpoints). Frontend: full user journey validated in mobile viewport (390x844) — login prefilled -> dashboard with 5 sensor cards + 3 recent alerts -> alerts list -> filter chips -> alert detail -> resolve -> profile -> sign out -> back to login.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses MongoDB _id as string uuid and correctly maps to 'id' in Pydantic — no ObjectId leakage.
JWT_SECRET has a safe default in code but is provided via env — good.
All backend endpoints are prefixed with /api — correct for k8s ingress routing.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — correct Expo pattern.
All interactive elements have testID attributes — good testability.
server.py is 423 lines — under the 700-line threshold but starting to grow; consider splitting into routers (auth, sensors, alerts) if adding features.
seed_data_creation: Used seeded demo user/alerts/sensors from backend startup. Test created one webhook alert with prefix 'TEST_' and one extra sensor reading via public endpoint. No cleanup needed for MVP validation.
